method: Labs 0.9.0, eight fresh-process blocks per case, before and after variants interleaved in a serial round-robin schedule. Medians are the median of block medians. Times are per invocation on a 10k entity world. The changed case writes 100 values, all other cases process 10k entities. Source fingerprints hash sorted relative path, NUL, file SHA256 and newline.
corrections: C1: Bare spawns do not satisfy tracking queries. Static relation maintenance also uses the tracking matcher.
C2: Initial population seeds all complete and partial groups, then applies the same static, tracking and relation conditions as live updates.
C3: Opposite structural events invalidate tracker bits. Destruction clears every query tracker and slot-indexed history. Changed history is cleared when the trait is removed.
C4: Cache and trait-index publication follow successful construction. Failed target setup unsubscribes its callbacks.
C5: Relation snapshots filter implicit sources, probing the smaller hidden set first when possible.

comparisonMethod: Before/after views were derived from the same raw run by selecting variants and removing their name suffix. Block data and samples were unchanged. These are not additional measurements. The Labs baseline marker was restored to boundary-before.

retainedMemory.method: Eight fresh processes per shape and variant. Alternating case order. Full GC heapUsed plus arrayBuffers. 10k entities, one scalar, one tag, optionally one populated Added query with reserved tracker pages.

limits: The changed-value cases are noisy and statistically inconclusive. Clock drift was 5.7% in the final run.
Tag toggles and destruction deliberately perform additional invalidation and lifetime cleanup. Their regressions are retained for correctness.
The relation snapshot case has one implicit definition with no matching pair, exercising the smaller-set probe. It does not measure the cost of filtering many implicit pair sources.

Retained memory includes heapUsed and arrayBuffers after full GC. The populated Added query now retains tracker pages for complete and partial groups. Raw per-invocation heap values are not a proof of zero allocation.
The initial benchmark run did not contain the destruction case. All other workflows are unchanged in the final harness.
